title: T4 live and the stated LWW premise is contradicted by a second writer

context.consumers: seller web app, repricing job, admin console

expected_feedback: Standard (S2, nature [C], trigger T4 live — §8.1 row 'a policy is stated, but the design contradicts the premise the policy rests on': **FAIL**). A write-conflict policy *is* stated, so this is not the 'no policy' case, and last-write-wins is not being reported as inherently wrong. What fails is the justification: the spec says LWW is safe because only the owning seller writes a listing, while the same service ships a nightly repricing job and an admin console that both PATCH price_cents. The premise is false, and a seller edit silently overwriting a repricing run is a real lost update on a money field. Name the second and third writer as the evidence — that is what makes this a factual contradiction rather than a preference. Fix either side: add ETag/If-Match with 412 on mismatch, or route batch repricing through a separate field or a merge rule, or amend the spec to state honestly that three writers race and lost updates are accepted — but that last option is hard to defend on price.
